summary: If a PR fails for unrelated reasons like network or VM timeouts, rerun CI by commenting /rebuild or /rebuild_failed, closing and reopening the PR, or pushing a new change.
questions: How do I rerun failed CI on an Ansible PR?
My PR failed because of a timeout, how do I retry?

answer_card.title: Rerunning failed CI
answer_card.answer_md:
For transient failures (repo access, VM timeouts):
- Comment `/rebuild` (full) or `/rebuild_failed` (only failed nodes)
- Close and reopen the PR (full rebuild)
- Push another change

If it persists, contact the community.
